Mayor's Blog Update (Published: August 6, 2026)

On Thursday, August 6, city staff conducted a street collection for disaster relief funds at Higashi-Hanno Station and Hanno Station.

All donations received will be forwarded through the Japanese Red Cross Society to the disaster relief distribution committees established by the affected prefectures, to support the immediate living needs of those affected.

Collection activities are also planned for Friday, August 7 at Higashi-Hanno Station and Hanno Station. We sincerely pray for the swift recovery and reconstruction of the disaster-affected areas.

Source (Japanese): https://www.city.hanno.lg.jp/shiseijoho/shichoshitsu/shichoblog/shisei2026/shisei202608/14164.html
